notes: Standard 96.5% (about 23K). Per LBMA: no import/export duty on bullion; bars VAT-exempt; 7% VAT on the full value of imported jewellery, and on making+spread only for domestic plain jewellery. Making, bar buyback and used-gold % removed in review round 1 (blog/aggregator support only).
